DI_ce_shared_diplomacy_set = {
    scope = character
    effect = {
        save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_ce_skill_selected_target value = DI_ce_diplomacy_target_value }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_owned_story = {
                    story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
                    has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var
                }
            }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = pinned_characters
                limit = { is_alive = yes }
                hidden_effect = {
                    add_diplomacy_skill = { value = define:NSkills|MAX_DIPLOMACY multiply = -1 }
                    add_diplomacy_skill = scope:DI_ce_skill_selected_target
                    force_character_skill_recalculation = yes
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            if = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes }
                hidden_effect = {
                    add_diplomacy_skill = { value = define:NSkills|MAX_DIPLOMACY multiply = -1 }
                    add_diplomacy_skill = scope:DI_ce_skill_selected_target
                    force_character_skill_recalculation = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
